apps.name: Dream Eater: Dream Journal
apps.description:
You wake at 3 a.m. with a dream still vivid. Say it out loud or type it, and Dream Eater keeps it safe, with the real moon and sky of that night beside it.

THE JOURNAL IS FREE, FOREVER
Voice capture that works offline and turns your words into text on your iPhone. Drafts that survive a crash. A calendar, search, tags, favorites, export. No account, no sign-up, nothing standing between you and the half-remembered.

A READING IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Ask for a reading and get a reflection, not a verdict. It quotes your dream back to you, asks open questions, and names the tradition when one reads an image a certain way (Jungian, Gestalt, folk). It never claims a symbol has one fixed meaning, and it never claims to know what will happen.

THE MOON AND THE SKY
Every dream is stamped with the moon phase and the Moon's sign from that night, computed on your iPhone. Add your birth details if you like, and see your chart and what is passing through it. Astrology here is a reflective lens, not evidence about your life, and it is optional.

PATTERNS THAT ARE TRUE
See your streak, your tones and feelings, the themes that keep coming back, and when you dream. If you ask whether the moon matters, the app tells you honestly how many nights it takes to say anything, and shows what chance alone would give you.

ART MADE FROM YOUR DREAM
Turn a dream into a picture in one of six styles, from soft dreamscape to ink wash to collage. Save it, or share a card with the dream's title and the moon.

BUILT FOR THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT
A Record button on the Lock Screen and in Control Center, a moon widget, a Bedside theme that keeps the light low. Large text, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion are supported throughout.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your dreams, recordings, transcripts, tags and birth details stay on your device. When you ask for a reading, the dream text goes to our server and on to Google's Gemini model to write it, and our server keeps no dream text afterward. You choose whether readings are on, and you can delete everything from Settings.

FREE, PLUS, OR PAY AS YOU GO
Three readings a week are free. Plus unlocks unlimited readings, dream art in six styles, follow-up questions and your sky. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or skip subscriptions and buy credits that never expire.

Dream Eater is for reflection and entertainment. It is not medical, psychological or therapeutic advice. If you are struggling, support is one tap away in Settings, Help, Crisis resources.

Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings, Apple Account, Subscriptions. A lifetime purchase is also available.

apps.name: Psywave: AI Playlist Maker

Turn any photo or mood into a real playlist in seconds — then play it in Apple Music with one tap.

Psywave is an AI playlist maker for people who hear a moment before they can name it. Pick a photo — a sunset drive, a rainy window, a party — or type a vibe like "neon city at 2 a.m." or "Sunday coffee, slow and warm", and Psywave builds a playlist of real songs that fit.

PHOTOS BECOME PLAYLISTS
Psywave reads the light, colors and mood of your picture and scores it with real tracks. Share a photo to Psywave straight from the Photos app, or ask Siri: "Make a playlist in Psywave."

FAMILIAR HITS OR DEEP CUTS
Choose how adventurous each playlist is: crowd-pleasers, a mix, or the underrated album tracks you haven't heard yet. Playlists include artists from your own country when they fit, and come back titled in your language.

ONE TAP INTO APPLE MUSIC
Every song is matched to the Apple Music catalog, so what you see is what plays. Preview any track, remove what you don't like, add ten more, then import the whole playlist.

SHARE THE VIBE
Share a link anyone can open: every song links to Apple Music, with search links for whatever app your friends use. Each playlist also gets a story-ready card with a scannable code. Using another service? Export a track list you can import there.

PSYWAVE PRO
• Unlimited playlists
• Longer playlists, up to 50 songs
• Only songs new to you: skip what's already in your library
• Grow any of your own Apple Music playlists with songs that fit

Start with 3 free playlists. Psywave Pro is a monthly or annual subscription, or buy credit packs and pay only for what you make. Credits never expire, and if Apple Music has almost none of a playlist's songs in your country, the credit comes back automatically.

apps.name: Double Kick: Menu Translator

Standing in front of a menu you can't read? Point your camera and know exactly what to order.

Double Kick turns any foreign-language menu into a guide you actually understand. Not a word-for-word translation that leaves you guessing, but the real story behind every dish and drink: what's in it, how it's made, what it tastes like, and what it costs in your own currency. Snap one photo and decide with confidence.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE ORDERING
- Read and translate menus in any language from a single photo
- Understand ingredients, preparation, and flavor before you commit
- See prices converted to your home currency, instantly

A REAL FOOD & DRINK EXPERT
- Explore regional specialties and global cuisines in plain language
- Decode spirits, cocktails, and wine lists that simple translators skip
- Learn the dishes behind the names, not just the words

BUILT FOR TRAVELERS
- Works on menus from street stalls to fine-dining tasting menus
- Keeps your menu history on your device for every trip
- Tracks your taste preferences across cuisines and trips

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account required, no ads, no tracking
- We don't sell your data. The menu photo you scan is sent securely to an AI service to be translated, and your menu history stays on your device

NO SUBSCRIPTION
Free to download, with no ads and no account. Menu scans run on credit packs — 20, 60 or 150 scans — that you buy once and top up only when you need more. Nothing renews, and there is nothing to cancel.

The next time the menu is in a language you don't speak, you won't order blind. You'll order exactly what you want.

Photograph a menu and see for yourself.

apps.name: App of the Dead: Religions
apps.description:
Where will your soul go when you die? Six of the world's oldest traditions are about to tell you.

NEW IN APP OF THE DEAD 2.0: THE JUDGMENT
Nine questions, about two minutes. Thoth reads the record of your life, Charon asks for his coin, Odin asks how your story ends, and Anubis lays your heart on the scale against the feather of Ma'at. Then the verdict: where you would go by the rules of Egyptian, Greek, Norse, Aztec, Zoroastrian and Buddhist belief, from the Field of Reeds to Valhalla, Mictlan to the House of Song. Share your Soul Card and dare your friends to face it.

22 AFTERLIVES, ONE APP
App of the Dead turns comparative religion into a game. Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Sikhism, the Egyptian Duat, the Greek underworld, Norse Hel and Valhalla, Aztec Mictlan, Zoroastrianism, Shinto, Taoism and more. Each tradition is a path of short story-card lessons on a map of its own, ending in a mastery test.

LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Multiple-choice, matching and true-or-false questions with instant feedback. XP, streaks, achievements, Game Center leaderboards, and a Daily Omen: one question a day from any tradition.

TALK TO THE GODS
Ask Anubis about the weighing of the heart, Odin about Valhalla, Hecate about the crossroads, Azrael about the grave. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence the Oracle answers instantly; on other iPhones it downloads once. Either way it runs entirely on your iPhone, so your questions never leave it.

A FREE WEEK AFTER YOUR VERDICT
Finish the Judgment and every path and every god opens for seven days, if you have not bought anything yet. Nothing to sign up for, nothing to cancel. The Judaism path stays free forever.

GO PREMIUM
Premium unlocks all 22 paths and unlimited Oracle conversations, yearly or monthly. Prefer to own it? Unlock a single path, or take Ultimate lifetime access.

Built with care for every tradition: no ads, no account, VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support.

apps.name: Psybeam: AI Voice Translator
apps.description:
Psybeam is a real-time AI voice translator for travel. Hold a button, speak, and the person in front of you hears it spoken aloud in their language. Hold the other button while they answer, and you hear them in yours. No typing, no reading, no app on their phone.

It is a live speech-to-speech interpreter in your pocket: it detects what was said, translates it as you speak and speaks it back in a natural voice that follows the speaker. Order food, ask directions, check into a hostel, talk to a pharmacist or a taxi driver, face to face, in seconds.

WHY PSYBEAM
• Voice to voice, live. Not a text translator with a speaker button: the translation is spoken as it happens.
• One phone, one operator. You hold the phone and run both directions from two thumb buttons. The other person just listens, then speaks when it's their turn.
• The translation faces them. Your words, in their language, rotate to face the person across from you. Their reply stays upright for you.
• No account, no sign-up. It opens straight to talking.
• No subscription, no trial trap. Start with free minutes, then buy a minute pack only when you need more. Never a recurring charge.
• Your conversation stays on your device.

22 LANGUAGES, SPOKEN BOTH WAYS
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Finnish and Swedish. Any pair, either direction.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your language and theirs, or let Psybeam suggest the local language from where you are as you cross a border.
2. Hold your button and speak. Release, and it says it aloud in their language.
3. Hold their button while they reply. You hear the answer in your language.
That's the whole app.

BUILT FOR TRAVEL
Markets, restaurants, hotel and hostel desks, taxis, pharmacies, train stations, asking a local for help. Any moment when you and someone else don't share a language. Works with Voice Isolation for noisy streets and cafés.

PRIVACY
Audio is streamed directly to our cloud translation provider only to translate it and is never routed through our servers. Your transcript never leaves your phone. You can withdraw cloud AI consent at any time in Settings.

iPhone, iOS 18 and later. Open it, hold a button, and have your first conversation across a language barrier in seconds.

apps.name: Pay Day: E-Invoice & Peppol
apps.description:
Most invoice apps make a pretty PDF. Pay Day makes one your tax authority's system can actually read.

The EU is switching to mandatory electronic invoicing. Belgium requires every VAT-registered business to send and receive structured e-invoices over Peppol since 1 January 2026, with fines for a plain PDF. France went live on 1 September 2026, and small businesses must issue e-invoices from 1 September 2027. Germany follows in 2027 and 2028, and EU-wide cross-border e-invoicing arrives in 2030. A normal PDF is no longer enough. Pay Day is built for exactly this moment, on your iPhone, with no desktop software and no monthly bookkeeping suite.

FREE, AND GENUINELY GENEROUS
- Unlimited invoices and estimates. No per-document limit, no watermark, no "upgrade to export."
- Unlimited clients, your logo, and multi-currency with European Central Bank reference rates.
- A real EN 16931 VAT engine: standard rates, intra-community reverse charge, zero-rated and exempt lines — with a correct, properly rounded VAT breakdown on every document.
- Works fully offline. Bill from a job site, a train, anywhere.
- No account required to start. Open the app and you're invoicing.
- Your country's e-invoicing rules on the dashboard: what is mandatory, since when, and what to set up.
- Live VAT validation: check every client's VAT ID against the EU VIES service before you issue.

PRO — REAL E-INVOICE COMPLIANCE, NOT JUST A PDF
- Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoices: a single hybrid file that looks like a clean invoice to your client and carries embedded EN 16931 data a tax authority's system can read automatically. Independently validated as a valid PDF/A-3 with valid EN 16931 XML.
- Peppol delivery: send your invoice straight into your client's accounting system over the EU's official network — no email attachment, no portal logins.

CREDIT PACKS — PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU SEND
- Top up with consumable credit packs that cover each Peppol network send (we pass through the real per-send cost rather than padding a subscription).
- The same credits power optional AI helpers: snap a photo of a quote or receipt and turn it into line items, or type a rough description and let it draft the lines. AI actions cost a few credits each and are entirely optional — the app is complete without them.

WHO IT'S FOR
Freelancers, consultants, designers, developers, and small businesses across the EU who invoice other businesses and need to be ready for e-invoicing mandates — without paying for a heavyweight accounting platform.

HONEST PROMISE
The free app is a complete invoicing tool, not a trial. We only ask you to pay where it genuinely costs us or genuinely earns you compliance: structured e-invoices, network delivery, and AI. No fake urgency, no nagging, no surprise limits.

Pay Day Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual. Peppol network sends are metered separately via consumable credit packs on every Pro plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. Credit packs are one-time purchases.

apps.name: Helia: UV Index & Sun Safety
apps.description:
Helia is the honest solar coach. Most sun apps either push you to maximize a tan or just show a raw UV number. Helia does neither. It treats sunlight like what it is — something to enjoy on a budget. The sunburn is the enemy, not the sun.

Helia reads today's UV conditions for your exact location and your skin, then gives you one clear answer: roughly how long you can be in the sun before you should cover up, reapply, or head for shade. That answer — your sunburn budget — is free, forever. We never put safety behind a paywall.

THE FREE SAFETY CORE — for everyone
• Hands-free tracking. Helia can notice when you head out into daylight, meter the session itself, and log it — no timers to start or stop.
• Your sunburn budget. A personalized estimate of how long today's sun may take before your skin has had enough, based on the live UV index and your skin type.
• The Answer. One glance tells you whether it's a cover-up day, a quick-session day, or a stay-out day — no decoding color charts.
• Live UV index + forecast. See the UV climb and fall through the day so you can plan around the harshest hours.
• Cloud- and rain-aware. Helia corrects the UV for the real sky, so an overcast day reads honestly — not as full sun.
• Reapply & cover-up nudges. Gentle reminders to top up sunscreen or step into shade before you've used up your budget.
• Honest by design. Helia rounds toward caution. When in doubt, it tells you to protect.

PRO — the coaching layer (optional)
Pro turns Helia from an instrument into a coach, with guidance grounded in how sunlight affects the body across the day:
• Morning-light timing. Helia suggests when a little outdoor light may help support your daily rhythm and energy — the circadian side of sunlight.
• Your vitamin-D plan. A 12-month, season-aware calendar of what sunlight can realistically contribute at your latitude — including the honest winter months when it can't. The live estimate on Home stays free.
• The Sun Atlas. Every session and every walked Sun Trail on one map — your sun, over time.
• On-device science coach. Ask anything about sun, UV, vitamin D, and your body clock — answered privately on your phone, grounded in cited sources, never the cloud.
• History & trends. Your sun, your budget used, and your patterns over weeks and seasons.

WHY PEOPLE KEEP HELIA INSTALLED
Helia isn't trying to get you a deeper tan or sell you fear. It's a quiet, trustworthy instrument that earns its home-screen spot.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Helia works for you, not on you. Your sun sessions, skin type, and location stay on your device wherever possible and are used to personalize your estimates — not to profile you. Precise location is used only to read your local sun and UV conditions. The coach runs entirely on your device.

A NOTE ON HEALTH
Helia provides general wellness estimates and guidance, not medical advice. Sunburn-budget and vitamin-D figures are estimates based on public UV data and the details you provide — they may differ from reality. Helia does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. For anything concerning your skin or health, please consult a qualified clinician.

Get the free sunburn budget today. Upgrade to Pro when you want the coaching.

Helia Pro is available as an annual or monthly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

• Monthly — $1.99 / month
• Lifetime — $29.99 one-time (never renews)
Prices may vary by region. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Embr is a fast, native Twitch client built for iPhone — not a wrapped web view. Streams open in a real AVPlayer with picture-in-picture, background audio, and instant quality switching. Chat is rendered natively so it stays smooth even in the busiest channels. No bloat, no clutter, just watch and chat.

Browse without an account. Star the channels you love to keep them one tap away, and sign in with Twitch only when you want your follows and to join the conversation.

WATCH
• Native AVPlayer video — live streams, VODs, and clips
• Picture-in-picture and background audio — keep watching while you use other apps
• Audio-only mode for listening with the screen off
• Quality selection, latency display, and landscape fullscreen
• Double-tap to seek, and adjustable playback speed on VODs

BROWSE & DISCOVER
• Favorites — star any channel and see who's live at a glance, no account needed
• Live channels and top categories at a glance
• Search channels and categories instantly
• A Following tab that surfaces who's live (when signed in)
• Rich channel pages with everything you need to dive in

REAL-TIME CHAT
• Live chat over Twitch EventSub — fast and reliable
• Animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ, all merged together

apps.name: Crucible: Plex Client
apps.description:
Crucible is a native client for your Plex Media Server on iPhone and Apple TV. It is built to feel like part of the system: the system player, native menus and context menus, Liquid Glass on the newest software, and a library that opens exactly where you left off.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Home opens on a Resume hero, then Continue Watching, Up Next and Recently Added. Library grids have filters for Unwatched and In Progress, genre and sort, an A–Z scrubber and folder browsing for unindexed content. Search groups results by type with a Top Result.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Skip Intro and Skip Credits from Plex markers, audio and subtitle menus, adjustable speed, lock screen controls and Up Next that rolls the next episode as the credits start. On iPhone: Picture-in-Picture and background audio. Direct play when your device can handle the file, automatic transcoding when it can't.

MADE FOR THE COUCH
The Apple TV app is built for the Siri Remote: a cinematic Home that follows focus, one tab per library, native context menus, search, and Top Shelf with Continue Watching and Up Next. Liquid Glass on tvOS 26.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
On iPhone, download movies, seasons or single episodes in the quality you pick. Transfers continue in the background, stay on Wi-Fi by default and show a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Offline playback uses the same player.

KNOW YOUR VIEWING
Watch History grouped by day, Statistics with streaks, heatmaps, binges and taste built from your own Plex history, and a Year in Review poster you can share.

FREE TO USE, CRUCIBLE PRO TO GO FURTHER
Browsing, search and playback are free on iPhone and Apple TV, and so is the Statistics view for the last week. Crucible Pro unlocks unlimited offline downloads, the full Statistics screen with every range and library filter, the Year in Review poster and Top Shelf. Pay once for lifetime access, or subscribe yearly. One purchase covers iPhone and Apple TV, and Family Sharing is on.

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER
No Plex server yet? Choose Try the demo on the welcome screen to explore a fictional library with everything unlocked, guided by a short tour.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no ads, no analytics. Crucible talks to plex.tv and the server you choose, and records Crucible Pro purchases with an anonymous Midgar ID, with no sign-up.

OPEN SOURCE
Crucible is free software under GPL-3.0: https://github.com/guitaripod/Crucible

Crucible needs a Plex Media Server. Plex requires a Plex Pass or Remote Watch Pass to stream from your server away from home. Crucible is an independent app and is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Plex, Inc. Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc.

apps.name: Flaccy
apps.description:
Flaccy plays the music you own at full quality: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3 and AAC. A real equalizer, gapless playback, synced lyrics you can share as a video, Last.fm scrobbling, a full iPad layout and a standalone Apple Watch app. No account, no ads, and your files never leave your device.

SEE EXACTLY WHAT YOU'RE HEARING
• Codec, bit depth and sample rate on every track, from CD quality to Hi-Res
• Gapless playback that honors your albums (exact for lossless files), with a queue that survives relaunches
• A built-in Listening Guide that explains what Bluetooth, AirPods and wired DACs really deliver. No snake oil

A REAL EQUALIZER
• Drag the curve and hear it change, or switch to Advanced for up to ten bands with bells, shelves, filters and adjustable Q
• 16 presets and your own. Import Equalizer APO and AutoEq profiles to tune for your headphones
• A separate setting for every output: AirPods, a wired DAC, the speaker. Flaccy switches when you do
• Automatic headroom keeps boosts from clipping, and Hold to compare is level-matched, so louder never sounds better
• Works with every format and keeps playback gapless. Off or flat, the signal passes through untouched

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• Bring music in from the Files app, USB, a NAS or any folder; Flaccy keeps your folder structure
• Messy filenames and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically (AI cleanup is included in the trial and in Lifetime)
• Albums, artists, songs and playlists with fast search, flexible sorting and large artwork you can replace with your own
• Duplicate songs are listed once, and Flaccy builds smart playlists from your own listening

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Home picks up where you left off, with mixes made from your own listening and what you played on this day in years past
• Synced lyrics that fill in word by word when a song has word timing, with tap-to-seek and a timing control for songs that run off
• Share Lyrics: pick the lines you love and get a short video of them over the song itself, in four looks and four formats for Stories, posts and more
• Full controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, AirPlay and a sleep timer
• Light and dark appearance, and a Now Playing screen worth looking at

BUILT FOR IPAD
• A sidebar for your library and every playlist, with Now Playing and Up Next in a column beside it
• Lyrics and the queue spread across the screen next to the artwork
• Keyboard shortcuts, the menu bar, pointer support and drag and drop: songs into Up Next or onto a playlist, audio files straight from Files

YOUR SERVER, TOO
• Play from Navidrome, Flaccy Server or any OpenSubsonic server, over your home network or Tailscale
• Songs stream without filling your iPhone or iPad and download for offline when you want them
• One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch

SCROBBLE EVERYTHING
• Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled, even offline, with automatic retry
• Listening charts, artist bios and a wantlist for the records you're hunting
• Year in Music: shareable story cards and a poster of your listening year

APPLE WATCH, NO PHONE NEEDED
• Sync tracks to your watch and play them offline
• A true standalone player with gapless playback, shuffle, repeat and AirPods controls
• Storage-smart sync that knows what fits

TRY IT FREE
Flaccy is free for 7 days from the first time you play your own music. After that, keep everything with a one-time Lifetime purchase, or choose the yearly plan. The yearly plan renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Flaccy plays FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF and CAF.

apps.name: Tailscode: Coding Agent Remote
apps.description:
Your coding agents don't stop when you leave the desk, so neither should you. Tailscode puts every agent running on your own computers in your pocket: Claude Code, opencode and Oh My Pi, on any model they can run, including one on your own graphics card. Start a task from the couch, check on six at once from anywhere, and get a ping when the long one finishes. Your chats go straight to your machines over your own Tailscale network, never through a relay, with no sign-in. Free and open source.

ONE COMMAND TO SET UP
For Claude Code, one line on the computer you code on installs the bridge and ends with a QR code. Scan it, confirm, and the app has your machine; opencode has a one-line installer too. Want to look first? A built-in demo shows the main screens with no server at all.

EVERY AGENT AT A GLANCE
• Home is one ranked board: a sentence that says who needs you and what is working, then the chats waiting on you, working, pinned and recent.
• The Agents board shows what needs you, what is working, what runs in the background and what finished in the last hour, with approve and answer on each card. Watch turns it into a full-screen wall of every agent.
• Peek at any agent without opening its chat: its step, its last moves, its context.

ANY MODEL, EVEN YOUR OWN GPU
• Whatever your agent can run, from cloud models to a local model served by Ollama or llama.cpp on your own machine, picked per chat with its reasoning effort.
• Carry a conversation to another model: the next one gets a short brief of the chat and picks up the thread.
• A party of six favourite models and their effort levels, one tap or one swipe of the model pill away.

LONG RUNS, NO BABYSITTING
• A Live Activity on your Lock Screen for a running conversation, one for each with Pro: what it is doing, for how long, and how many tools it has run.
• Notifications say what happened: how long it took, what it changed and the first of what it said. Reply from the Lock Screen to start the next turn. An approval shows the exact command and asks for Face ID or your passcode; a question shows its options as buttons.
• Queue the next message while a turn runs, edit it before it goes, or stop the turn on the server.

A NATIVE TRANSCRIPT, NOT A TERMINAL
• Megatron folds a turn's thinking and tool runs into one head you open to read, search and replay every step.
• Diffs, commands and their real output inline; syntax-highlighted code with byte-exact copy.
• Send screenshots and photos; every picture the agent hands back lands in a gallery.

NOT ONLY CODE
Your machines know things. Ask what is eating the GPU, research a question, tidy a folder, check a price: any agent, any model, from anywhere.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
• Every conversation priced, every month totalled across machines, by model, project and tool. Always an estimate, never a bill.
• Plan limits and quotas per provider and account, with the pace and turns left, on Home and in widgets.

YOURS, END TO END
• Your chats travel point to point over your tailnet, never through a relay. No sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and your code and conversations never reach us.
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, plus a Linux desktop app, all open source under GPL-3.0: the app, the engine and the bridges.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core on one server: full chat, the Agents and Home boards, approvals, attachments, every model, a Live Activity at a time. Tailscode Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: unlimited servers in one list, concurrent Live Activities, iPhone and Mac on the same Apple Account, the delegate board, and a supporter heart.

Tailscode is independent open-source software, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Tailscale Inc., the opencode project or Oh My Pi.

apps.name: Living Dex: Animal Identifier
apps.description:
Turn the real world into your personal collection. Point your camera at a bird, bug, plant or mushroom, or pick a photo, and Living Dex names it, rates how rare it is where you are, and adds it to your Dex.

Nothing alive in sight? Every Dex begins with a starter: choose one real species to open your collection, then go and find the rest.

HOW IT WORKS
• Spot something alive: a garden bird, a wildflower, a beetle, a toadstool
• Tap to catch. Cloud AI names the species, then the name is checked against GBIF, the world's biodiversity database, so invented species never reach your Dex
• Every catch becomes a card with a real rarity, from Common to Legendary

WHAT YOU GET
• Illustrated realms of life: animals, plants, fungi, protists and more, to sort and filter your Dex by
• Real rarity: how often a species is recorded near you, plus conservation status for threatened species
• A Nearby Dex: every species that lives around you, shown as locked slots painted with the realm's art, waiting to be found
• An illustrated Field Guide that explains each realm and how identification works, free to read
• Field entries that teach you something, and the sound of the call where a recording exists
• Daily streaks, XP and levels that reward getting outside
• Share any catch as a collectible trading card
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements
• No account needed

FREE TO START
Every device starts with 30 free identifications. After that, go Pro for unlimited identifications or buy a credit pack. Browsing your Dex, the Nearby list, the Field Guide and field entries is always free.

Living Dex Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Identifications are AI-generated best guesses and can be wrong. Never eat, touch or handle a wild plant, fungus or animal based on this app.
